blocks.text: INQUIRER.net / Updated as of: 08:25 AM November 10, 2026

MANILA, Philippines — The defense team of Vice President Sara Duterte is set to present the city assessor of the Island Garden City of Samal as its second witness on Tuesday, Day 41 of the impeachment trial.

items: Samal City Assessor Engr. John Kenneth Enumerables is expected to testify on the property linked to Duterte and her husband, lawyer Manases Carpio.

His testimony comes as the defense seeks to counter the prosecution’s allegation that Duterte failed to declare or improperly declared the Samal property in her statement of assets, liabilities and net worth (SALN).
After Enumerables, the defense is expected to call Matina Crossing Barangay Captain Cindy Colina to testify on the barangay’s official name and identity.
The defense is presenting its witnesses to challenge the allegations raised by the prosecution against the vice president.
On Monday, the defense opened its presentation of evidence on Monday, calling Davao City Assessor Engr. Jaime Adalin as its first witness. /dp
